title: Open Seminar; Between a Rock and a Hard Place in Contemporary Spains
description: The original title in Spanish, "Lo que no pasa", points to Nietzsche's maxim "What does not kill me, makes me stronger", while evoking lasting moments in contemporary Spains, when poets and other souls of maldizer journeyed between utopias and exiles. But it also alludes to the supposed longevity as well as denial of certain civil, cultural, identity and territorial fractures.
